narrative.intro: Brookhaven Science Associates has $842M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Energy obligated $842M, making DOE the dominant buyer. Brookhaven Science Associates has 2 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $421M. Obligations are up 1.0% year over year. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration also bought services, with $16K in obligations. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) accounts for $842M of Brookhaven Science Associates’ obligations, with a small related NAICS line showing $16K. Current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the numbers shown are contract obligations except where table notes indicate award-value totals. This snapshot highlights a concentrated funding profile: most obligations flow from one agency into one primary market, while a very small amount comes from another agency and a closely related NAICS category. The dataset shows continuity with prior fiscal years, where obligations ranged from $668M to $951M in FY21 through FY25 and now register at $842M in FY26 to date.
